title: Neighbours
intro: The live ARP (IPv4) and ND (IPv6) table of the data plane, static neighbours and the neighbour-table settings. Router advertisements, proxy ARP and proxy ND are set per interface (Interfaces → interface → “IPv6 RA, proxy ARP/ND”).

flush.title: Flush learned entries
flush.text: Deletes the learned ARP/ND entries; the data plane learns them again on the next packet. Static neighbours are kept.
flush.readonly: Your role can only view the table.

static.intro: Static ARP/ND entries (the address must lie in a connected subnet of the interface) and the VPP-wide neighbour-table limits and duplicate address detection. Saving writes the candidate; commit to apply.
static.saved: Saved to the candidate. Review and commit it in the pending-change bar.
static.globals: Limits and duplicate address detection are VPP-wide: only the product agent (the globals owner) applies them.

ipv6Ra.title: IPv6 router advertisements
ipv6Ra.help: absent = VPP defaults (RAs suppressed); untick “Suppress” to send RAs; the interface needs an IPv6 address

proxyArp.title: Proxy ARP
proxyArp.help: answer ARP for the proxy-ARP ranges of this interface’s VRF

proxyNd.title: Proxy ND addresses (experimental)
proxyNd.help: experimental and off by default: applied only by an agent started with VRX_DF2_PROXY_ND=1
